final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / NULLIF(replacement_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS n FROM film GROUP BY rating), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM s1) SELECT s1.rating, s1.avg_ratio, s1.n, s1.avg_ratio - s2.overall AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.overall IS NOT NULL
